runtime.note: The source references ./support.js but the package does not ship it. The repository renderer (tools/design-render/dc-runtime.mjs) supplies a compatible adapter. For implementation comparison, the tracked Procurement runtime (docs/design/procurement/source/support.js, SHA-256 8fe7df74405f3c55f49b7249c74ea1397e65d07dea2b1bd3b4a489bec2e28cbe) was used unchanged, from a scratch copy outside the repository, to render the reference. No runtime file was added to or copied into the POS package. The reference was rendered this way for the visual-only implementation comparison (all 31 screens at 1366x768, 1280x720, 1368x800 and 1920x1080) with Playwright and system Chrome; the scratch copy and the PNGs are not in the repository. The real runtime fetched React and the fonts and icons from their CDNs.

approval.scope: Visual reference only. Does not approve any business, API, data, security or hardware decision. Frozen specifications and the Decision Register remain the authority. It does not by itself approve implementation: the frontend-only implementation is governed by ADR 0008 on its own WIP branch.

limitationsAccepted: support.js is not shipped with the package, so repository renders use the compatible adapter; the fidelity report lists the 31 screens as RUNTIME-COMPLETE with the known-missing support.js (render of 2026-09-27).

implementationApproval.scope: Fictional-only visual implementation under ADR 0008. It approves how the screens look and how the fictional states and dialogs step, and nothing else. No real sale, payment, card, refund, receipt, shift close, calculation, persistence, API call, sync, authentication or hardware operation exists or is approved.

boundTo.hashScheme: SHA-256 of each file's bytes. implementationDigest is the SHA-256 of the lines 'path<TAB>sha256<LF>' sorted by path (C order). candidatePathsDigest is the SHA-256 of the candidate paths joined by LF with a trailing LF, sorted by path.
boundTo.note: The 7 documentation and tooling paths in the candidate list are not hashed here because several of them record these hashes and cannot contain their own. They are bound by path. Changing any hashed implementation file voids this binding until the owner re-approves.

implementationApproval.intentionalVisualDifferences: Listed in docs/phase-0/visual-pos-screens.md, section 'Differences from the approved reference': devices and providers shown as not tested or not connected, receipt not printed, cloud pill not checked, real MM-006 Store Node pill, stub controls with a dashed outline, fixed fictional lines and totals, preset-only search results, preview-only labels, dialog focus handling, hidden h1 and skip link, fonts from the same CDN link, and the History STATUS-header overflow inherited from the reference.
limitationsAccepted: Everything shown is fictional presentation; totals, change, refunds and differences are fixed strings.
Fonts load from the Google Fonts CDN; bundling is an open decision.

While the History detail pane is open (screens 17 and 28) the STATUS header overflows its 0 px track at every tested viewport, and at 1280x720 the CUSTOMER header is clipped too. This is inherited from the reference.
Pixel comparison against the reference is a similarity measure, not a fidelity certification.
